Great Thai food experience!
May 2019 • Couples
My wife and I went here as we walked round the Saigon Centre and thought about grabbing something tasty to eat. I am not one for signs out the front of restaurants as they are usually written by themselves in a shameless self promotion. I thought the food here was great. I had the mixed appetiser for my main meal as I was not really that hungry. My wife had seafood pad Thai and it was great as well. I had a bit of it and it had a fantastic flavour too it. Mine was some Wontons, Thai fish cakes, pamello salad with 3 Chicken skews as well. This was very yummy and once I had polished this off, I was very satisfied. Great job Nara. The staff were very friendly and the were quick with our drinks and food. I would go back Gain in a heart beat. Lovely food, great prices and a good location in the Saigon centre. Third floor location, up with a lot of other restaurants that mostly did Asian style food dishes.

Horrible food
Apr 2019 • Couples
Today we ate in this restaurant. We ordered amongst other things crispy crab in yellow curry, a red beef curry, sticky rice and a coconut soup. First the food dishes arrived and when we asked about it, they brought the soup. In our opinion the sou is a starter but okay, can happen. 
The crab curry was more like crap curry. It was definitely no crab and the sauce, which is supposed to be a soft creamy smooth sauce was thick. It went sour and looked greasy. Moreover, it had a bad taste and was actually not edible.
We mentioned it to the waitress who nodded her head, made some sort of apology but did nothing to solve the problem.
Maybe she couldn’t as no one of the boys and girls serving our table managed to speak more than 2 words in English. Acceptable and understandable in any little restaurant downtown HCMC but not so in a place which is for more than 50 % visited by foreigners.
When we asked for the bill and put money in the leaflet nobody came back with our change, as they apparently decided that it wasn’t worth the trouble returning it to us and leaving it to us wether we’d give a tip or not. In this case we didn’t feel like tipping for any service we didn’t get. 

Overall this is a restaurant I would certainly not recommend at all. I know there are far more better places to have dinner than this fake Thai restaurant. Don’t go there!

Staff needs to get their act together
May 2018 • Couples
This would have easily been a 4 star review, unfortunately I had to remove a couple of points for unnecessary blunders by the staff and crew.

I ordered Stir Fried Chicken with Cashews and a Thai Tea with Tapioca Pearls. My girlfriend ordered Spicy Ground Pork with Sticky Rice.

The restaurant is very nice and our waitress was friendly, everything looked spotless.

Our orders arrived, as you may recall I ordered Cashew Chicken, there was not a single cashew in my Cashew Chicken (one star removed.) I called one of the staff over and inquired about the lack of cashews. They apologized and took my plate away. I decided to try my Thai Tea, the tea itself was very good, it tasted just how Thai Teas should taste, unfortunately they replaced the Tapioca Pearls (like it was shown in the menu) with some kind of jelly pearls (another star removed.)

My order was brought out again, my Cashew Chicken now had cashews! 

This would be a good place to eat if they could get their act together but I will not be returning to find out if the staff has received the training that they so desperately need.

I can not recommend Nara Thai.
